scope: HATCH/MPOLYGON boundary-point conversion through the four-term stable OCS transform selected when elevation plus boundary Z overflows.

finding.priorBehavior: The four-term transform normalized boundary X/Y/Z and elevation by one common maximum magnitude. This could underflow a small nonzero coordinate before the remaining elevation and boundary terms were rotated and canceled/distributed.
finding.change: When common scaling erases any nonzero term, recompute the four bounded basis products at their original exponent scale, combine the largest opposite-sign pair first, and accumulate remaining products and fused multiplication residuals with compensation.
finding.scopeBoundary: Only the finite mixed-scale cancellation case is covered. HATCH entity storage, serialization and native meaning are unchanged.

generatedControl.elevationAndBoundaryZScale: Each Z contribution is 0.6 * DBL_MAX; their direct sum overflows.
generatedControl.purpose: Verify finite rotated elevation/boundary-Z components and preservation of the tiny orthogonal coordinate that common normalization previously erased.

unresolved: Correct rounding for every finite four-term OCS input is not established.
Native CAD rendering and external producer qualification remain open.
claimEffect: Closes only the generated tiny-coordinate loss in the HATCH/MPOLYGON elevated OCS point path. No DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
